seo.meta_title: 에라 모르겠다 Meaning | Not 'I Don't Know' — From BIGBANG
seo.meta_description: AI translates 에라 모르겠다 as 'I don't know'. It means giving up and doing it anyway: 'Oh, whatever!' When to say it and when not to.

ai_failure.situation: A friend stares at a menu for ages, then says 에라 모르겠다, 다 시키자! You ask AI what 에라 모르겠다 means.
ai_failure.ai_mistake: Translates it as 'Well, I don't know', as if your friend is unsure of something.
ai_failure.why_it_fails: It isn't about knowledge. 에라 모르겠다 means 'I'm done worrying — whatever happens, happens', usually right before an impulsive decision. Closer to 'Oh, whatever!' or 'Screw it'. BIGBANG's 2016 song 에라 모르겠다 (English title 'FXXK IT') used the phrase.

natural_solution.rule: 에라 모르겠다 = giving up on thinking, then acting. Say it to yourself or friends, never to a boss.

alternatives.context: 'Forget it, I'm going to sleep' — giving up on homework or work for the night
Polite, at work: 'I'm not sure' — the actual 'I don't know'

nuance: 에라 is an exclamation of frustration that only appears in phrases like this one. Said to a manager, 에라 모르겠다 would sound like you've stopped caring about the task.
